# Foldover — Implementation Tasks & Design Notes

## Overview

- **Source**: ColorLib Accordion 12 (`https://colorlib.com/wp/template/accordion-12/`)
- **Assigned Name**: Foldover (`apps/foldover`)
- **Category**: UI Components / Accordion Showcase

## Section Order & Architecture

1. **Header / Hero Section**: Title and description introducing the accordion collection.
2. **Accordion Container**: Group of collapsible cards featuring questions/features, interactive chevron icons, and smooth transition states.
3. **Features / Highlights Grid**: Supporting cards illustrating use cases or benefits.
4. **Call to Action**: Newsletter signup or download banner.
5. **Footer**: Branded footer with copyright and mandatory link to `https://www.componentdock.com/` ("Component Dock").

## Fidelity Notes

- Clean modern styling inspired by the Accordion 12 reference screenshot.
- Dark/light neutral contrast with vibrant accent highlights.
- Fully accessible keyboard navigation and ARIA attributes for collapsible items.
